# Coverage assignment cards, engine side (2026-11-23)

Coverage, C14. Diagnosis only: no builds. Develop 0226f0d3 (engine-91 plus the film notes), flags at their defaults.
Companion to Rules' taught cards (`docs/reviews/2026-11-23-coverage-cards.md` on `rules/coverage-cards`): the same
template, headings and row numbers, so the two files diff line for line. The user's read of the film: "we're just
leaving dudes way too wide open too often."

How to read this:
- **Section A** is the answer in short: the code paths that leave receivers with nobody, ranked by how often the
  situation comes up in ordinary passing.
- **Section B** traces the six film plays through the code: who owned the open receiver by our rule at each moment,
  and what that defender was doing instead.
- **Section C** is the simple arm (day-one coverage) for Tools' open-receiver census.
- **Section D** is the shared machinery behind every card: zone technique, the match rules, man technique, and
  what happens around them (alignment, run/pass key, run fit, play action, adjustments), each with file:function.
- **Section E** is the card for every coverage we can call × every seat (generated by
  `scripts/diag/coverage/engine-cards.mts` from the catalog and section D; "none" where no code exists).
- **Section F**, the ranked gap list against Rules' cards, follows as Rules pushes each family.

Flag note: several doc comments still say "(off)" for flags whose code is `!== '0'` (on). This file reports what the
code does: CUT_WALL, MOTION, MOTION_CHECK, DB_SLOWPLAY, LB_READ_STEP, READ_LEAN, BACKER_TAKEON, RUN_CONFIRM,
HONEST_READS, SLOT_LEV and TIGHT_OFF are on. Off: MAN_PHASE, HEAD, HONEST_FLIGHT, QB_STANCE, SAM_ON_TE. ZONE_HOLD = 114
(band hysteresis, bit 1, off).

## A. Why receivers are open: the code paths, ranked

Each item is a path in our code that, by construction, leaves a receiver related to nobody. Ranked by how often the
situation comes up in ordinary NFL passing. "One-sided" means a defender releases a receiver and no other defender's
rule reads the same cue to take him.

1. **No zone defender ever hands a receiver to anyone.** `ZoneCoverage` (defense.ts) has no pass-off: a defender stops
   relating to a receiver when the receiver's projected position leaves his band, when a carry threshold ends (seam
   carry stops at 10 yd for a curl-flat, 13 for a hook), or when a lane-pick filter drops him. Nothing tells a
   neighbour, nothing checks anyone took him. Band membership is re-decided every tick on the edge (ZONE_HOLD bit 1 off).
2. **The universal pass-under (CUT_WALL, on).** `CoverageDefender.passUnder` (coverage/defender.ts) rewrites every
   non-exempt rule's man or wall on a receiver read `under` at 7 yd or less into "wall him from my landmark ±5 yd, then
   my zone". In the code's own words: "the crosser is someone else's". Pickup happens only if he enters another *rule*
   hook's cutWall window. Plain zone seats (quarters hook_s/hook_w, cover6_area and cover8_trix hook_mid) guarantee
   nothing. Exempt: man calls, MEG corners, mush, rat, a curl-flat carrying #2 across, the apex in "two", Box's low-in.
   It also overrides the taught "match #3 underneath" of read_hook, bonus_hook, area_hook, banjo, mike_3's back angle
   and the apex's "one". Mesh, drive, shallow cross and slants run through this.
3. **#1's quick break vs MOD quarters, Cover 3 match and Deuce.** The corner zones off #1's shallow under/in/stop/out
   (`zoneOffOne`, rules.ts). The apex or curl-flat takes #2's flat. The quarters safety is "free" on a #1 shallower than
   7 yd (ROB_COMMIT bit 4). Deuce has no other underneath reader. Slant-flat, hitch-flat, quick-out-flat: #1 is
   nobody's by rule until a rule hook's window.
4. **Intermediate in-breakers (dig, in, Y-cross at 7-14 yd) vs Cover 3 match/Mable/Seam/Buzz.** The curl-flat zones
   off a #2 `in` unless #3 is away (`seamCurlFlatDeclared`). c3_hook's #3 carry is not latched: when #3 breaks in he
   falls to cutWall, which ignores ins and anything deeper than 7 (`c3Hook`, `cutWall`). mike_3 reads only the back.
5. **Play action takes underneath zone players out of coverage with no leash.** Any zone or match seat goes to his run
   fit the moment his read commits run (`ZoneCoverage.zonePlay`, `Technique.update`). The curl-flat or flat seat is
   the designated force (`run-fits.ts:buildRunFits`): ≈ 2.5 yd off the line outside the end man at 0.9 speed. No depth
   floor, no pass-first hold, no hand-off of the vacated zone; back only when his read flips or he sees the throw.
   Linebackers give receivers zero weight as pass evidence (`recognition.ts` KEYS: LB wr 0), so a receiver running past
   a backer does not pull him back. Only the quarters safety (SCREW) and man defenders on wide receivers (PASS_FIRST)
   have a pass-first rule.
6. **Backs: B before B2, and fakes read as releases.** `backTo` (rules.ts) returns B (the RB) before B2 (the FB)
   whenever B shows a non-none release; mike_3 and three_rec_hook read only B; man preference lists name B; recognition
   keys only the RB slot. A faking RB's lateral step reads as a release, so a rule latched on "#3/the back" can move
   from the fullback running the route to the back who isn't (F68).
7. **Stick, flat races and Smash-with-a-flat.** Push sends the curl-flat to a fast #3/back flat; the hook takes #2
   only if it read #2 vertical at that moment, so a settled stick is nobody's. A flat declared 2-3.5 yd deep is not
   "fast", so no Push and the flat is nobody's. Smash fires only on #1 `stop`, so a #1 shallow out with #2 vertical is
   nobody's. In Cover 2 match the sink corner takes the flat and the hitch is nobody's.
8. **Deep: verticals that fall outside every deep set.** The Cover 3 corner keeps only his #1 (and #2 in his third)
   once #1 is vertical; #3 seams and wheels drop out of his set. The deep-middle band ends ≈ 14.8 yd from the far
   sideline; the deep middle splits only the two deepest verticals. Underneath carries end at 10/13 yd and lane picks
   ignore anything projected past 16. A wheel or outside seam beside a #1 go is nobody's past ≈ 13-16 yd.
9. **Bunch and Area rules leave stops and seconds.** No Box/Area pool includes `stop`; the second out-breaker and the
   second in-breaker have no taker; Banjo with no #3 puts both banjo players on #1.
10. **Formations and motion we don't answer.** Structure checks consume only bunch_strong, stack_strong, empty_3x2,
    trips and close_23 (structure.ts computes nub, weak bunch/stack, closed trips, two-back, quads, iso and reduced
    tags that nothing reads). Cover 3 Sky, Cover 2, Tampa 2, Cover 6/8 and every man call have no empty answer. A
    backfield player flexed out turns trips into 3x2 so trips checks (Deuce DOT) don't fire (F15). After motion, the
    defense re-installs from a 0.3 s-old picture and walks at ≤ 0.75 speed; nothing after the snap (no renumbering).
11. **Man coverage has no switches.** `ManCoverage` has no switch on crossers, rubs or stacks, no banjo; the target is
    fixed at the snap; once hips open in a man call they never re-close; a man whose receiver stays in to block holds
    his spot over him with no rush, help or robber branch.
12. **Eyes on the wrong side.** `zone-eyes.ts:keyRefs` points hook_mid, hole, robber and both curl_s and curl_w at the
    strong #3/#2 for the first 0.9 s, so a weak curl defender's own side ages in his picture.

## B. The six film plays, traced

Replayed exactly: `scripts/film-room.ts collect --seed 101 --games 4` on `tools/film-room` (engine identical to
develop), the film set rebuilt with pick-seed 1; each play's concept, coverage and down match the user's notes.
Traced every 0.05 s with a read-only tap (each defender's job, rule mode, run/pass read). "Owner by job" = a defender
whose current job is man/wall/crossWall/trap/read/rob on that receiver.

**F09: Quarters → Poach (vs trips), Y-Cross; Y (#3) caught, 22 yd.** Numbering S1 Z, S2 H, S3 Y, W1 X.
- LB_W (read_hook on #3): read Y 0.25 s, then **zoned at 1.20 s** when Y released to the flat (read_hook: #3 flat/out →
  zone, leaving the flat to the apex or mush; Poach has no mush).
- NB (q_apex on #2): read H, walled H from 1.65 s, zoned at 2.75 s. flat3 (the apex taking a #3 flat) needs #2
  vertical past 10 yd; H was crossing, so it never fired.
- From 1.2 s Y belonged to nobody; at the throw (3.55 s) Y was 4.9 yd deep at the sideline, **15.7 yd from the nearest
  defender**. LB_W and NB both ended up near H: the user's "NB does not pass off H; LBW and NB both cover H".

**F13: Deuce → Deuce DOT (vs trips), Comebacks; H caught for 5 (−1 YAC).** The user's open X:
- X (W1) at the throw: 15.5 yd deep, **owner none**, CB_W 7.2 yd away. CB_W (sink_corner, flat_w: the DOT cloud corner) sat
  in the flat from 0.85 s, trailed X (man) from 2.35 s and went back to flat zone at 3.60 s. FS (deep_half_w, a plain zone seat) never related to X.
- RB at the throw: owner none, 11 yd from the nearest defender.
- H (the catch): LB_W (bonus/three rule) on H from 2.80 s, 7.3 yd away at the throw; NB 4.6 yd.

**F15: Deuce, Hitch-Out from trips; Z caught for 5.** Numbering S1 Z, S2 H, S3 Y, W1 X, **W2 RB** (the back flexed
out, so the set is 3x2: Deuce's `trips → deuce_dot` check did not fire).
- Deuce's four underneath seats (flat corners `palms_corner`, apexes `q_apex`) read #1 and #2 only. **Y's hitch (#3)
  had no owner by any rule**: at the throw Y was 5.0 deep, 6.2 yd from NB (who was walling H).
- Z's hitch (#1): CB_S man Z, then **zone at 2.25 s** on H's quick out (palms: trap #2, give #1 to the safety), trap H
  at 2.40. SS took Z ("one": over the top of #1) **from 17 yd deep, 13.7 yd away**. Z was caught at 2.2 s with owner
  none at the throw.

**F16: Cover 2 Match, Four Verticals; Z caught, 21 air, 6 YAC.**
- CB_S (sink_corner): flat zone to 1.30 s, then man Z trailing. The sink waits until #2/#3 and #1 have declared, so
  with nobody threatening his flat he stayed in the flat for 1.3 s. At the throw (1.95 s) he was 4.3 yd off Z; 8 yd
  behind him downfield.
- SS (deep_half_s, HALF_KEY): two verticals in his half (Z and Y); 14.9 yd from Z at the throw.

**F61: Cover 3 Seam + Will B-gap (shows Cover 6), PA Corner-Flat; Y (#2) caught, 4 air, 15 YAC.**
- NB (curl_flat_s, c3_seam) **never read run** (unsure → pass at 1.8 s). Y's play-action release stepped inside
  first (vy −2.4 at 0.95 s), which reads `under`; with #3 not away, c3_seam's "#2 in/under → zone" sent NB to **zone at
  1.30 s**. Y then bent out to the flat (vy +3 by 1.75 s) and NB re-matched him only at **2.05 s**; 8.1 yd away at the
  throw. Nobody owned Y from 1.30 to 2.05 s.
- SS (hook_s) read run until ≈ 3.0 s and walled crossers in turn (Y, X, RB).
- So on this play the loss is the release read on a play-action release (a selling TE), not the run fit; the run-fit
  path (A5) is the SS.

**F68: Cover 3 Match, PA Post-Cross from I-Form Jumbo; F (the fullback, B2) caught, 2 air, 13 YAC, touchdown.**
- Linebackers, the strong corner and SS read run 0.6-1.8 s; FS read run past 3 s.
- SS (curl_flat_s, c3_curl_flat): read H, zone at 1.15, **Push (latched) onto F at 1.35 s**, then **onto RB at 2.35 s**
  (backTo returns B before B2 once the faking RB shows a release), zone at 4.30.
- From 2.35 s F had **no owner**; at the throw (4.25 s) he was 10.9 yd from SS, who was on the faking RB. The user's
  "SS picks up a back who is not running a route while the fullback runs it".


## C. The simple arm (day-one coverage)

The user's instinct: start simpler and see how things look. The question the arm answers: does our match layer leave
more receivers wide open than plain day-one coverage does, or do the base drops and relations leave as many?

### What existing flags can and cannot do

- **Spot drops cannot be forced by a flag.** `src/game/playcaller.ts:917`: a call with any rule seat is always
  installed as `match`; Cover 2 and Cover 3 without rules are `match` or `spot` by the coach's `matchRate`
  (`src/league/team.ts:119`, drawn 0.3-0.9 per coach). `src/sim/assign.ts:146`: a seat runs its match rule
  (`CoverageDefender`) only when its style is `match` (its own `style`, else the call's `zoneStyle`); otherwise it is a
  landmark `ZoneCoverage`.
- **Structure checks have no flag.** `checkCall` (`src/playbook/coverages.ts`) always applies `structureChecks`
  (Cover 1 to Banjo vs bunch; Cover 3 to Mable/Clue; quarters to Box vs bunch and Book/Read vs empty; Deuce to DOT vs
  trips; Cover 6 to Book/Area). `QUARTERS_CHECK=0` turns off only the field/boundary 6-vs-8 and Palms-vs-MOD choices.
- **Flags remove refinements, not the match layer.** Each of these is on by default and switches off one taught
  refinement inside a rule or technique; the rules themselves keep running.

### Rung 2, spot (day-one; rung 1's flags plus one harness override, no engine change)

For the census harness only, on each play's defensive call before installation:
1. `defCall.zoneStyle = 'spot'` on every zone call: every rule seat without its own `style` is built as a landmark
   `ZoneCoverage` (spot drop to its landmark, the zone technique; no #1/#2/#3 rule).
2. Coverage pool restricted to the day-one call of each family: `cover1` (pure man-free as taught: man on the
   eligibles, FS deep middle, the hole/robber player, whose seat keeps its own match default in assign.ts), `cover3`
   (spot-drop Sky), `cover2` (spot-drop), `cover4` (quarters landmarks, no match conversions once spot). No pressures
   that bring their own coverage (Deuce, fire zones).
3. No checks: install the called coverage as called (skip `checkCall` / `quartersCheck` / Zeus).
4. `QUARTERS_CHECK=0` (redundant under 3, stated for clarity).

### Rung 1, refinements off (env flags only; the base rules still run)

`QUARTERS_CHECK=0 MATCH_DECLARE=0 MUSH_MATCH=0 MUSH_TRAP=0 C2_APEX=0 SQUAT_TOPDOWN=0 Q_APEX=0 CUT_WALL=0 BOX_IN=0
SCREW=0 TAMPA_PIPE=0 FLAT_SINK=0 FLAT_CARRY=0 CURL_SINK=0 OPEN_CARRY=0 HALF_KEY=0`

What each removes (docs/FLAGS.md rows): the Rip/Liz declare phase (MATCH_DECLARE); Book/Stubbie nickel #2-flat match and
the Soft Squat trap (MUSH_MATCH, MUSH_TRAP); the Cover 2 vertical-curl apex rule (C2_APEX); the squat corner's
top-down flat (SQUAT_TOPDOWN); the quarters apex #3/flat rules (Q_APEX); the hook's crosser wall and Box's in-breaker
variant (CUT_WALL, BOX_IN); quarters Screw on play action (SCREW); the Tampa pipe (TAMPA_PIPE); the flat seat's sink
and carry (FLAT_SINK, FLAT_CARRY); curl-flat sink (CURL_SINK); the open carry posture (OPEN_CARRY); the Cover 2 half
safety's #1-to-#2 key (HALF_KEY). What it keeps: every base match rule (c3_*, q_*, palms_*, cloud/sink corners,
vertical_hook, read_hook, mush, box, area, banjo, ...), every structure check, the coach's spot/match draw.

### How to read the census

Rung 0 is develop as it is. Tools runs the open-receiver census on all three (sent 2026-11-23, with a per-family split
so the different call mix stays like for like).
- Rung 2 leaves **fewer** men wide open than rung 0: the match layer (rules, checks, conversions) is the problem.
- Rung 2 leaves **as many**: the base drops and relations (landmark technique, threat sets, eyes, breaks) are.
- Rung 1 between them says how much is the recent refinements against the base rules.

## D. The shared machinery

### D0. Which code runs a seat

- `src/sim/assign.ts:assignBehaviors` (≈ 130-157): a zone role with a `rule` and style `match` gets a
  `CoverageDefender` (coverage/defender.ts), which runs the rule every tick (0.05 s) and builds a new technique when
  the directive changes; any other zone seat gets a `ZoneCoverage` (behaviors/defense.ts); a man role gets
  `ManCoverage` with the snap-time target from `defAlign.spots[slot].manTarget`; a man defender left without a man
  and a `spy` become a robber `ZoneCoverage`.
- Style: the seat's own `style`, else the call's `zoneStyle`. Calls with any rule are always `match`
  (game/playcaller.ts:917); plain Cover 2 and Cover 3 are `match` or `spot` by the coach's `matchRate` (0.3-0.9).
- Receivers are numbered #1-#3 outside-in per side at the snap (after motion; motion.ts `realignOffense`); an attached
  TE is numbered; backs are B and B2. No renumbering after the snap (`ReleaseReader.sideNow` has no caller).
- Release reads (coverage/reads.ts:ReleaseReader.read), each defender through his own delayed picture: block → flat/out
  (outward > 1.8 yd/s and > 0.6·upfield; flat under 3.5 yd deep) → under/in (inward, under below 6.5 yd) → vertical
  (upfield > 2.5, past the line: READ_VERTICAL_LOS) → stop (under 2.2 yd/s past 2.5 yd); a new class must persist
  0.12-0.19 s; BACK_CLEAR keeps a protecting back's slide from reading flat.

### D1. Zone technique (`ZoneCoverage`, behaviors/defense.ts ≈ 1737-2547)

- **Each tick** (`updateCore`): pursue a live carrier → break on a believed throw (`playsThrow`/`playBall`) → flat
  seats: `flatCarry`, `flatSink` → underneath plant on the QB's load (SHOULDER_READ) → `zonePlay`: run fit if he reads
  run; a box backer read-steps until he reads pass; then deep, red-zone flat, spot or match underneath branches.
- **Threat set**: every non-OL, non-QB player (backs included); a threat when his position projected 0.7 s ahead is
  in the zone's lateral band (`zoneBand`); no depth filter; re-decided every tick on the band edge (hysteresis only
  for deep halves and the deep middle, HALF_OWN).
- **Landmarks** (playbook/alignment.ts:zoneLandmark): deep third 16 deep, 10.4 from the sideline; deep half 15 /
  13.5; deep middle 15 at the ball; quarter out 13 / 8 from the sideline; quarter in 12 / ball ±7; curl-flat 8.5 /
  ≈ 12 outside the ball; flat 4 / 9 from the sideline; hook 10 / ball ±5; hook_mid 10.5; curl 11 / ≤ 9 outside;
  robber 11; hole 6. Spot style sinks the underneath landmarks 1.5-2.5 yd.
- **Deep**: plays the deepest vertical in his band. Third and quarter corners keep only their own #1 (and the third
  corner #2 in his third, OWNED_FIX) once #1 is vertical. Cushion 1.6 + 0.16·vx − 0.6·anticipation, inside
  shoulder; turns on a broken cushion; two verticals: split (0.65/0.35 toward the QB's look, halves 0.5). HALF_KEY
  (deep halves): keys #1 to #2. Pattern drive on a stopped #1 (match style only).
- **Underneath, match style**: seam carry (climbing faster than 4.5 yd/s, 2-10 yd deep for a curl-flat, 2-13 for a
  hook, within 6 yd of the landmark); CURL_FLAT_BACK widen toward a back/#3 showing outside; lane pick (score by
  distance to the landmark, the QB's look −3, current pick −1.5; under radius + 2); two-man curl/flat expand (no #3, no
  fast back); otherwise the landmark leaned with the QB's head. With a pick: 82% of the way from the QB to the
  receiver, never more than 0.5 yd in front of him; crossers faced along the route; settle after the QB sets.
- **Underneath, spot style** (`spotUnderneath`): drop to the landmark; once within 2.5 yd, receivers matter only
  through the QB's eyes (move toward the looked-at receiver's lane by 0.45 + 0.4·read; squeeze the in-zone receiver
  nearest the landmark at 0.3); no QB look read → stand on the landmark. No carry, crosser or expand.
- **Eyes** (zone-eyes.ts:keyRefs, zoneEyesTarget; head.ts:stepHeads): head on his key for 0.9 s (flat/curl-flat
  #2→#1; hook_s/w #3→#2; hook_mid, hole, robber, curl_s and curl_w the **strong** #3→#2; thirds, halves, quarter-out
  #1→#2; quarter-in #2→#1), then the QB; on a believed release, the receiver his shoulder read picks. The QB-look read
  needs the QB within 100° of his body facing.
- **Pass-off: none.** He stops relating to a receiver who leaves his band, ends a carry, or fails a pick filter.
- **Break**: underneath and quarter seats key the QB (load → stop the drop; seen delivery → run to the receiver the
  shoulders point at, ±25° with error; else the ball). Held deep seats (thirds, middle, halves, tampa_mid: DEEP_GATE)
  break only on the ball seen plus reaction.

### D2. The match rules (coverage/rules.ts, `runRule`)

Per-rule detail is in each card's rows 5, 6, 8 and 10c (section E). Shared pieces:
- **Latching**: a rule's `state.mode` (push, smash, delivered, zoned, one, two, three, four, flat, flat3, trap, match,
  widen, handed, screw) persists for the play; unlatched branches re-read every tick, so a seat can flip man/zone as
  release labels change (sink corner, c2_hook, c3_hook's #3 carry).
- **CUT_WALL pass-under** (coverage/defender.ts:passUnder): see A2.
- **CoverageJudgment** (coverage/judgment.ts), deep seats only: overrides the rule to protect an uncapped climber
  within 14 yd laterally, or robs a short break when no climber is uncapped.
- **Coordinated hand-offs** (both rules read the same cue): quarters apex/safety on #2's seam (apex walls to 10,
  safety takes at 7); Palms corner/safety on #2's quick out; MOD corner/apex on #1 shallow (only when #2 is not flat or a
  quick out); Smash curl-flat/corner on #1 stop; read_hook with poach/stubbie on #3's vertical (8 vs 6); three_rec_hook
  with bonus_hook on #3 under/stop. Each still reads through his own delayed picture with a 0.12-0.19 s confirmation.
- **One-sided or sight-conditional**: every hand-off "to the hook" or "to the safety by sight" (curl-flat delivery and
  c2_hook on a seen cap), every pass-under, every release at a carry depth (c3_hook and mike_3 at 15, cloud/sink at 15,
  vertical_hook at 18).
- Unused: `invert_safety` (no call uses it; cover2_invert's safeties run cloud_corner).

### D3. Man technique (`ManCoverage`, behaviors/defense.ts ≈ 1315-1659)

- **Assignment** (alignment.ts ≈ 1250-1316): coach overrides; preference lists in slot order; any receiver still
  uncovered to the nearest unassigned man defender (DBs penalised for backs and inline ends); spare men take the call's
  underneath seats or robber. Fixed at the snap.
- **Alignment**: press 1.2-1.3 just outside head-up (corners, slot DBs), off 6, slot 4.5, backs 5, overTop 10;
  TIGHT_OFF 4.5 over a tight #2.
- **Each tick**: true ball-in-air → play the ball; pursue a live carrier; his man a back seen carrying, or a back/inline
  end blocking, on a run read → run fit (PASS_FIRST keeps him on a detached receiver); DB_SLOWPLAY gives ground on a
  run read; else `trackReceiver`.
- **trackReceiver**: leverage 0.7 yd inside (0.9 trail, 0 head), the inside side recomputed from the ball each tick;
  cushion press 0.8, off ≤ 5.5 shrinking with depth (CUSHION_NEED, OFF_PEDAL: an off defender with closed hips never
  comes forward before the throw); hips open on a consumed cushion or a crosser and never re-close in man calls;
  overTop 0.8 + 0.15·vx over him; trail 0.6 under.
- **Eyes**: no look target; his body facing. Throw cues: the ball in view, or his man's hands within 3 yd.
- **Switches, banjo, traffic: none.** A man whose receiver stays in to block holds his spot over him.
- **Motion**: none in ManCoverage; the snap-time install decides.

### D4. Around the technique

- **Alignment and shell** (alignment.ts:alignDefense): corners by landmark and press (flat 4, half 8.2, third/quarter
  7.3, press 1.3, off man 6); two-high safeties 12-14 deep (quarters 12), one-high post 14.5-14.7; down safety 4.4-5.8
  by TE and QB; slot DBs over a detached #2 (SLOT_LEV) or at the apex; backers from the front table 4.3-4.8 deep, apex
  walk-outs in zone calls. Disguise: a call's built-in `look` (Cover 9, Buzz, Cloud), or the playcaller's `shown`
  shell (`alignDisguised`). **No rotation rule**: at the snap each seat heads for his landmark from where he stands, at
  his drop pace (underneath seats slowed by 0.3 + 0.7·pPass until they read pass).
- **Run/pass key** (recognition.ts): a filtered pass probability from a situation prior plus cues (OL stance and
  movement, pulls, QB depth and mesh, the RB slot's path, receivers' releases or blocks), weighted by group (LB: OL 1,
  pull 1, QB 0.8, RB 1, **WR 0**; S: OL 0.8, QB 0.6, RB 0.4, WR 0.7; CB/NB/DB: WR 1.4); commits after his observation
  delay; a seen throw is +4 and sticky.
- **Run fit** (run-fits.ts:buildRunFits, executeRunFit): the flat or curl-flat seat on each side is the force (gap D,
  ≈ 2.5 yd off the line outside the end man, speed 0.9); backers insert (2.25 yd landmark); everyone else alley
  (max(5, align−1) deep at the back's y +1.2, speed 0.65).
- **Play action** (A5): only the RB slot fakes (assign.ts PlayActionFake), the OL shows run (pa-look.ts), and nothing
  tells a defender it's a pass; every zone and match seat is in his run fit once his read commits run, back only on a
  read flip or a seen throw; backers' passPull only slows the attack. Exceptions: quarters SCREW; PASS_FIRST and
  DB_SLOWPLAY for man defenders on wide receivers.
- **Formation checks** (coverages.ts:installCoverage, checkCall, quartersCheck, resolveZeus): see each card's row 10a.
  Tags consumed: bunch_strong, stack_strong, empty_3x2, trips, close_23. Never consumed: quads, empty (non-3x2),
  bunch_weak, stack_weak, trips_open/closed, nub, two_back, iso_weak, reduced. `cover1_lurk` checks trips before
  bunch, so a 3x1 bunch never gets Banjo. A check whose slots a pressure spent silently keeps the unchecked call.
- **Underneath seats** (alignment.ts ≈ 1186-1220): filled in priority order by least total distance; a pressure drops
  the lowest-priority seats (Cover 3 loses hook_mid first); extra defenders get duplicate hook_mid seats; nothing
  matches seats to receivers.
- **Motion** (motion.ts:MotionRuntime, MOTION_CHECK on): offence motions on 50% of passes (across .45, return .15,
  jet .25, RB to empty .30). The defence re-installs every 0.2 s on a 0.3 s-old picture (checks re-run), walks at
  ≤ 0.75 vmax, exchanges jobs by least squared distance (corners keep sides; deep jobs only to safeties; WR man jobs
  never to backers); man calls lock the motion man 51-69% by type, a locked man trails a jet. Nothing after the snap.

| 6 | relation to threats | never deeper than 0.5 yd in front of his pick; carry ends at 10 yd | - |
| 7 | eyes | head on W2, else W1 for 0.9 s (ZONE_EYES), then the QB as he sees him; on a believed release, the receiver his shoulder read picks | zone-eyes.ts:keyRefs/zoneEyesTarget; head.ts:stepHeads |
| 8 | pass-off | none; the carry ends at 10 yd with nobody told | - |
| 9 | break trigger | keys the QB: plants on the load, breaks on the seen delivery to the receiver the passer's shoulders point at (25°, with error), else on the ball | defense.ts:believesThrow, underneathPlant, shoulderTarget |
| 10a | formation adj. | none for this call (coverages.ts: no checks); seats are landmarks filled by nearest free defender, not matched to the receiver count | - |

No #2: man #1 if climbing (rules.ts:qSafety, helpOneCommitted); underneath it, quarter_s_in: landmark 12 deep, ball ±7; owns his #2; if the owned receiver is not vertical he plays the deepest vertical in his band | - |

| 9 | break trigger | keys the QB: plants on the load, breaks on the seen delivery to the receiver the passer's shoulders point at (25°, with error), else on the ball | defense.ts:believesThrow, underneathPlant, shoulderTarget |
| 10a | formation adj. | call checks: bunch_strong → pounder_banjo (coverages.ts:installCoverage/checkCall); nothing for quads, weak bunch/stack, nub, closed trips, two-back | - |
